name: John H. (Jack) Hickey
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Miami, Florida
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, Products Liability, Transportation & Maritime
about: We are licensed in Florida. We have had cases all over the United States. We can handle any case where the accident or medical malpractice happened in Florida. We can also handle any crewmember or cruise passenger case, most need to be filed in Florida.

Jack was born and raised in Miami. He graduated from Florida State University undergrad and Duke Law School. He started his career at Big Law with Smathers & Thompson in Miami. For the first 20 years of his career, he represented cruise lines, railroads, and other self-insured corporations. He then made the transition to representing plaintiffs.

Jack is Triple Board Certified: Trial Lawyer by The Florida Bar and NBTA; Admiralty & Maritime Law by The Florida Bar. Jack serves on the AAJ Board of Governors and on the FJA Board of Directors. Jack is currently Chair of the Section Leaders Council (SLC) of AAJ. Jack has chaired for AAJ Premises Liability Section, Motor Vehicle Section, and the Admiralty Section. Jack is a Past President of the (Miami) Dade County Bar Association and was on The Florida Bar Board of Governors for 12 years.

Jack is a Member and Life Fellow of the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA). He is also recognized by the National Trial Lawyers in the Top 100. Jack holds an AV Preeminent rating from Martindale Hubbell.
Jack lectures and writes frequently - and with enthusiasm- on trial technique and preparing cases for trial.
